package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

// PlanningSnapshotReader returns one consistent read-only Student owner
// observation. Implementations must not progressively observe independent
// transactions or call Course/Practice/Runtime to assemble it.
type PlanningSnapshotReader interface {
	ReadPlanningSnapshot(context.Context, string, string, []domain.LearningTargetRef) (domain.PlanningSnapshotSource, error)
}
